backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping features to related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of frontend file paths with short descriptive summaries for each component or page.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining color tokens, dark mode variables, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining metadata and loading the main React bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up app routing and layout, mapping paths to pages including guides and tool pages.
frontend/src/components/guides/GuideArti: Layout wrapper for guide articles with breadcrumbs, metadata badges, and styled content container.
frontend/src/components/guides/GuideCard: Clickable card displaying guide metadata, excerpt, and publish date using UI components.
frontend/src/components/home/FeaturedToo: Featured tools section with responsive layouts, horizontal mobile scroll, and animated tool cards.
frontend/src/components/home/Footer.tsx: Renders a multi-column site footer with logo, quick links, tool categories, social links, and year/branding info.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: Displays the homepage hero with animated background particles, headline text, and primary action buttons.
frontend/src/components/home/IntroSectio: Provides an introductory text section explaining the platform’s purpose and benefits.
frontend/src/components/home/LatestGuide: Shows a header and grid of the latest guides with a button linking to the full guides list.
frontend/src/components/home/ToolCategor: Renders a grid of tool category cards with icons, descriptions, and subtle float animations.
frontend/src/components/home/ToolIconPar: Implements a canvas-based floating icon particle animation with reduced-motion and mobile handling.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main page layout with route transition animation, footer, and mobile bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Bread: Creates a breadcrumb navigation bar with links and current-page highlighting.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Mobil: Provides a fixed mobile bottom navigation for jumping to tool categories via hash scrolling or redirect.
Wraps a Lucide icon in a styled container for consistent tool icon presentation.
frontend/src/components/shared/TrustSect: Displays a grid of trust-focused cards highlighting privacy, security, and platform reliability.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and helpers for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageSeo.ts: Updates and restores the document title and meta description based on the provided SEO options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query backend hooks; currently empty.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode settings, and custom component/utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/guidesRegistry.ts: Stores metadata for site guides and exposes helpers to fetch all guides, look up guides, and get recent ones.
frontend/src/lib/toolsRegistry.ts: Holds metadata for available tools and provides lookup and related-tools helper functions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static About page describing the site's mission, offerings, and benefits using styled sections and icons.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact form page with validation, submission simulation, and informational sections.
frontend/src/pages/DisclaimerPage.tsx: Renders the disclaimer page with sections describing warranty limitations, accuracy limits, and user responsibility. Presents structured text with headings and bullet points.
frontend/src/pages/guides/GuideKeyboardS: Provides a guide article about productivity keyboard shortcuts with SEO metadata and structured lists of shortcut categories.
frontend/src/pages/guides/GuideOrganizeB: Offers a guide on managing browser tabs and bookmarks, covering tab strategies and bookmark organization within an article layout.
frontend/src/pages/guides/GuidePdfWorkfl: Renders a guide article page with SEO metadata and a multi-phase PDF workflow checklist. Uses GuideArticleLayout to display structured content sections.
frontend/src/pages/GuidesPage.tsx: Displays a guides listing page with SEO setup, breadcrumbs, a header, and a grid of guide cards fetched from the registry.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Composes the homepage by rendering hero, intro, trust, categories, featured tools, and latest guides sections.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Shows a 404 page with messaging and a button linking back to the homepage.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPage.tsx: Renders the privacy policy with sections on data collection, usage, and browser-based file handling, including notices and structured content.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Displays terms and conditions with sections outlining service description, user obligations, permitted use, and general rules.
frontend/src/pages/tools/ImageCompressor: Implements an image compression tool UI with file upload, drag-and-drop, progress simulation, previews, and download/reset actions. Integrates with the shared ToolLandingOnlineFreeTemplate.
frontend/src/pages/tools/PdfToWordOnline: Provides a PDF-to-Word converter interface with PDF validation, drag-and-drop upload, simulated conversion progress, and demo DOCX generation. Uses the shared landing template for layout.
frontend/src/pages/tools/ToolLandingOnli: Defines a reusable landing-page template for online tools, including SEO setup, hero section, tool interface container, benefits, steps, FAQs, and related tools. Wraps UI components and layout logic for consistent tool pages.
frontend/src/router.tsx: Implements a simple client-side router with context-based navigation, link interception, and direct route matching. Provides Router, RouterProvider, Link, and useRouter utilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with extended color tokens, animations, component theming, container settings, and plugin integrations. Defines custom CSS variables for UI styling across the app.
project_state.json: Defines the project's mobile‑first goals, existing mobile UX features, and pending requests focused on performance, navigation, layout, and touch targets.
